name: node-proxy-checkpoint-container
why: a container checkpoint through nodes/proxy (POST, audit verb create): the kubelet writes the container memory and file system to an archive on the node, which can hold secrets; emulate.sh f does NOT call this live (the dump is a disk write on the node), so it is covered by this case only (see TRR9002 Procedure F)

name: node-proxy-containerlogs-pod-named-pods

name: service-proxy-pods-path

name: node-proxy-pods-status-confounder

name: node-proxy-pods-empty-segment
